verdict.rationale: Runpod's docs state that its first-party CLI (runpodctl) is open source, so part of the product's own tooling can be read. The core GPU cloud platform is not shown to be open, and no license is named. Missing for 10: an open-source license for the core platform, a named license (e.g. Apache/MIT), a linked source repository, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license

citations.quote: Runpod CLI is an open source command-line tool for managing your Runpod resources from your local machine.
Runpod CLI is an open source command-line tool for managing your Runpod resources from your local machine. You can manage Pods, Serverless endpoints, templates, network volumes, and models
